title: The Game Score You Nudged
youtube_title: The Game Score You Nudged | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Hiding a dent does not make the dent untrue.
summary: At a kitchen table with jam, butter, and a shared pencil tin, Femi is tangled up with a game score nudged by one mark and almost hides it. Femi tells Ms. Okonkwo the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
